title.zh: US Aims to Turn Stablecoins Into a Weapon for Dollar Dominance
title.en: US Aims to Turn Stablecoins Into a Weapon for Dollar Dominance

current_state.zh: The Trump administration is reportedly considering joint ventures with private firms, backed by Treasury, the State Department and the US International Development Finance Corp., to promote dollar-pegged stablecoins in foreign markets and expand the roughly $200 billion in Treasury bills already held by issuers.
current_state.en: The Trump administration is reportedly considering joint ventures with private firms, backed by Treasury, the State Department and the US International Development Finance Corp., to promote dollar-pegged stablecoins in foreign markets and expand the roughly $200 billion in Treasury bills already held by issuers.
